description: September 6 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 2, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 6 birthday falls in Virgo, in the second decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: September 6 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Care, in the language of September 6, is a verb. With the Sun near thirteen degrees of Virgo and Saturn as the decan's sub-ruler, service is taken seriously and done properly. The birthday number 6 is linked with home, family and responsibility, so this date is often associated with the person who remembers everyone's dietary needs, mends the gate and rarely asks to be thanked.

On September 6 the Sun usually sits at about 13° Virgo, in the second decan, where Saturn is the sub-ruler alongside Mercury. From 10 to 19 degrees of Virgo the sub-ruler is Saturn, which also rules Capricorn. Early-to-mid September birthdays therefore combine Virgo's attention to detail with a serious, long-term sense of responsibility. These natives are frequently described as dependable, disciplined and drawn to work that matters over years rather than weeks. They may carry duties others have dropped, without complaining about it. Saturn can also bring self-doubt and a reluctance to celebrate small wins. Allowing progress to count before it is complete often helps this decan enjoy the sturdy structures it is so good at building.

sections.heading: September 6 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 6th produces a birthday number of 6, unreduced. As the secondary number in a chart, the day of birth hints at how someone naturally contributes to the people around them. The 6 is the number of the household in Pythagorean tradition: care, responsibility, beauty in the home and fairness within the family. Those born on the 6th are often the friend who remembers birthdays and notices when someone is struggling. Their usual lesson is that looking after others works best when they include themselves in the circle of care too.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one September 6 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on September 6: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 6 is the 249th day of the year (250th in a leap year). By September 23, 17 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Libra.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by September 6, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on September 6 include John Dalton (1766), Jane Addams (1860) and Idris Elba (1972).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 6?
faq.answer: September 6 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 6?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 6 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 6th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 6?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 6 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 6?
faq.answer: September 6 is also the birthday of John Dalton (1766), Jane Addams (1860) and Idris Elba (1972). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
